map.鸡舍光照程序设计器 使用指南: Poultry Lighting Program Designer User Guide
map.选择鸡种类型与日龄阶段，生成科学的光照程序，包含各阶段光照时长与强度建议（如育雏: Choose the bird type and age stage to generate a scientific lighting program with duration and intensity recommendations per stage (such as 23 to 24 hours of strong light in the first three days of brooding), improving laying performance.
map.按鸡种（蛋/肉/种）与日龄给出光照时长。: Give the lighting duration by bird type (layer, broiler, breeder) and age in days.
map.密闭舍补充光照至目标时长。: Top up lighting in a closed house to the target duration.
map.产蛋期光照刺激方案。: Lighting stimulation scheme for the laying period.
map.：产蛋期建议恒定 16 h 光照（密闭舍自然 12h 须补 4h），促进排卵。: A constant 16 hours of light is recommended during lay (a closed house with 12 natural hours needs 4 hours added) to promote ovulation.
map.：前期 23h 促采食，后期降至 18~20h 平衡生长。: The first period uses 23 h to drive feeding, then it drops to 18 to 20 h to balance growth.
map.青贮饲料压实密度与pH值分析器: Silage Feed Compaction Density and pH Analyzer
map.光周期调控性成熟与产蛋，过长/短均影响产量与健康。: Photoperiod regulates sexual maturity and laying; both too long and too short affect yield and health.
map.自然光照随季变，须人工补光达到目标时长。: Natural daylight changes with the season, so lighting must be supplemented artificially to reach the target duration.
